question: Which city ranked eighth globally and secured the top spot in West Asia in the Global Power City Index 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is **Dubai**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Dubai** has secured the **8th position globally** in the **Global Power City Index (GPCI) 2024** and remains the **top city in the Middle East (**West Asia) for the second consecutive year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **GPCI**, released annually by Japan’s **Mori Memorial Foundation**, evaluates cities based on **six key areas**: **Economy**, **Research and Development**, **Cultural Interaction**, **Livability**, **Environment**, and **Accessibility**.
 
• Dubai excels in **innovation**, **economic growth**, and **global connectivity**, solidifying its status as a **global hub for business, talent, and investment**.
 
• **Sheikh Hamdan**, the **Crown Prince of Dubai**, attributed the city’s success to its **modern infrastructure**, **progressive laws**, and **strong public-private partnerships**.
 
• Dubai's achievement emphasizes its role in **setting global standards for excellence** and leading the way in **business and innovation** in the region.
